user.title: Connect Refract
user.description: In the Refract app open Integrations > Access and connected apps, create a personal key and paste it here. Enable the permissions you want Home Assistant to use.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Refract
reauth_confirm.description: Your key was rejected or revoked. Paste a new one for the same account.

error.invalid_auth: That key was rejected. Check it was copied in full.
error.missing_profile_scope: The key needs the 'See your public profile' permission.

abort.already_configured: This Refract account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That key belongs to a different Refract account.

init.title: Refract options
init.description: Posters are optional. They need your own free TMDB API key, and are loaded from TMDB's servers.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Refract is checked for changes.
data_description.fetch_history: Needed for 'Last 7 days' and 'Average per week'. History is refreshed hourly and can be many requests for large libraries.
data_description.tmdb_api_key: A TMDB v3 API key or v4 read access token. Leave empty to show no posters.
